reviews.text: Paid approximately €5000 for tests and a surgery we were told was "highly successful". Our dog had six weeks of good health before the issues recurred. UCD didn't want to know us at that point; very disappointing. Another vet referred to them as "a money machine" which says it all really. Will never use them again.

They took unbelievable care of my dog, unfourtuanetly our little man didn’t make it, but the staff went above and beyond and we have just collected his ashes which were giving to us with a really nice touch of our dogs paw print in a frame alongside the gorgeous urn with his ashes in. I Couldn’t recommend them enough as their professionalism and quality of work is second to none.

I am extremely dissatisfied with the care my cat received. After paying a significant amount for an overnight stay, I was shocked to learn at discharge that no temperature check had been performed since like 3 am, discharge was at 7. Instead of providing answers or a clear diagnosis, we were simply told to take our cat to our own vet.

The vet on duty was unable to provide any diagnosis despite carrying out blood tests, leaving us with no real understanding of what was wrong. After spending a considerable amount of money, I expected a much higher standard of care, thorough monitoring, and clear communication regarding my pet's condition.

I am very concerned about the level of assessment and attention given during my cat's stay and will be taking this matter further. Pet owners trust veterinary professionals to provide comprehensive care, especially when animals are admitted overnight, and unfortunately that was not our experience.The price was an absloute fortune.
No empathy, or compassion towards family pets, and I think they make the prices up, crazy money, for no compassion or understanding, id never return again.
Excellent staff. Excellent care.
Highly recommend!! On the Easter bank holiday my dog Kai experienced mould poisoning and I couldn’t thank the admin and the vet Jemma who looked after Kai enough! 🩵 …
Very nice staff ,its over to the right when u drive in gate

Great service we were well looked after
Great staff happy dogsx

My dog spent a week in the ICU here in February. Dr. Robyn is amazing — as are all the staff, the nurses, Dermot at the front desk, everyone. First class care from people who are genuinely good at what they do and clearly care deeply. You never want your pet to need a place like this, but if they do, this is the one. My dog still loves going back, which says everything about how well she was treated there. Eternally grateful.
Horrible so unempathetic brought my dog was having seizure told me if I didn’t have half tonight of 1400 and the rest the next day they couldn’t give him medicine and to be put down, horrible place

If you can ,go aelsewhere ,I paid for tests and diagnosis of my cats issue but they wouldnt give me full course of medication for diagnosis so expensive ,not so good place for animals in dire situations ,this crowd only care about their fees ,behaving like superior gods that decide on life and death for sick animal that needs two more days of antibiotics to finish treatment ,which by the way cost 29 cent per pill and he needs 6 of them ,but no no even with there tests and diagnosis 3 days ago, nurse today  on the phone needs to talk to  sick pet owner in a way that is disturbingly unapropriate and superior words like IF YOU NEED ANTIBIOTIC TAKE HIM TO US AND AFTER FEE WE WILL GIVE YOU !!  Its actually really bad when such a bad person is doing to job shes doing

What an amazing pet hospital. I have three pets who are chronically ill and I cannot recommend these guys highly enough. Such helpful people starting with the fantastic reception team to every other interaction I have had with any staff member. The detailed assessment that is provided to you so you can make the best choice for your best friend. I love the way that all patients stay overnight after procedures and sometimes more than one night depending on the treatment. At least this way you can know your pet is in safe hands in hospital where there are staff available in case of an emergency and you can sleep easy until you collect them. Thank you for taking care of my pets.

Unempatic, not throughout was there twice in less then 12 hours to be told my dog did require other medication but they hadnt got it there. Absolutely disgusting to leave a dog suffer and not to give the correct medication or information to owners. They charge enough. And because I refused to pay a revisit fee as I was told to return to just get bloods my dogs information has been withheld. Never bring your pets here they have no clue. Its 2am my dogs not breathing right im waiting to go to a 3rd vet visit as soon as somewhere opens.
Very attentive and helpful.

They saved my baby girl. We took her there when she was nearly dying and they did everything to save her. They took care of her very well and with all kindness and attention. Yes it is pricey but it worth it because they have the best support, machines, exams and staff. Now she is home, getting healthy and strong. I can’t thank them enough! ♡
Directions to the hospital marked poorly. Lost my soul as the best family member passed away while I was driving him around the UCD trying to follow Google maps.

It was a nightmare!!!! I took my dog ​​for surgery for a fracture last week in December, and they didn't put any protection on his paw after the surgery!!! I spent over €2000, and in the end, on the return visit, I had to pay for another x-ray, and his paw is broken again, and they want me to pay another €2000 or amputate the paw for €1200!!!! Terrible 😞 I'm really tired of dealing with this.
This hospital is great. Receptionist and vet were amazing and gave my family well informed options, empathy and sympathy as we had to put our beloved dog to sleep. Thank you guys so much.

I am extremely disappointed with the treatment and care for my friends dog received at this hospital.

Giorgio underwent surgery a few weeks ago, and unfortunately the procedure was not successful due to poor post-operative care and lack of proper follow-up. As a result, his condition worsened and he now needs a second surgery to correct what went wrong in the first one.

I trusted this hospital with my dog’s life and spent over €3,000 on the initial treatment, only to be told that another surgery is required, costing around €2,000, because the first one failed. This situation could have been avoided with adequate care, monitoring, and responsibility from the medical team.

Beyond the financial burden, this experience has caused enormous emotional stress. Seeing my dog in pain and suffering due to negligence is heartbreaking.

I hope this review serves as a warning to other pet owners and encourages the hospital to take responsibility and improve their standards of care, communication, and accountability.
Accommodating
Had to come here on Christmas Eve and they were great all around.

Absolutely awful. I'm sorry, I understand some do care, but I would never reccomend to bring a pet here for anything, not even a checkup. My cat was not cared for, prices always being the main priority, my baby could of died at home with us but they kept her instead. Not everyone there is awful, but I can never look at the place again without feeling awful. I do not want to go into detail, but I do not reccomend, and I hope that others don't have similar experiences.

They kept her overnight for nights not needed as they got money for it. The person caring for my baby treated her as a thing, to be sedated CONSTANTLY for no need and kept in a tiny cage. She was incredibly dirty like there was no bathroom for her, when we did manage to see her, she looked like hell. She died suffering because of the place she was sent too, and I wish I could of given her a better passing. They did not need to do everything that was done to her, it was clear that fees were the main priority.

We went on the weekend, where it is managed by a private veterinary organisation, I am unsure how the week works with students.
Thank you so much, legendary staff

There is no other way than to describe this experience other than APPALLING AND TRAUMATISING!

After being admitted from the ucd emergency one I was called by a doctor here and was told all the investigations that needed to be done. I asked about the cost, as I wanted to make sure I could afford it, and was told an estimate of 1500-2000 euros for hospitalisation and treatment but was told it might go up higher by 200-300 more just to be on the safe side. I agreed and was asked upfront to pay 1200 euros before they even had a look at my dog, that was possible even to pay through the phone. I paid and from there it went downhill. They did an MRI on my dog and they said the might need to do a biopsy for cancer as they suspect it’s cancer. But I also had the option to put him down to avoid unnecessary costs ad they felt it might be a better option given the circumstances. I asked them if it was because the cost of that particular biopsy was high, to which they assured me that it was included in the estimate given. I told them I wasn’t going to put a healthy dog of 5 and half years down with no other medical history based on an assumption and told them money isn’t an issue and do what is best for him.

They did…they gave him chemotherapy based on an assumption and as a conclusion they told me that the dog was critical but breathing. I have never met more moronic comments coming from a doctor in my life. I was angry and after a harsh exchange, suddenly the day after my dog was perfectly fine. For 5 days they have kept him there and during those five days they have asked me if I agreed on various procedures and every day I asked as they proposed something new if that was over the estimate. Every single time the answer was no. On release day a lady from UCD called to tell me to come collect my dog and gave me the total cost of everything. 4000 euros! I told her that I won’t be paying for that and that I have checked every time to see if there was any additional cost over the agreed estimated amount to which the answer was no. She asked again if no one told me about the additional cost and I said ‘if you think that someone would tell me I would have to pay double I wouldn’t know?! Your calls are recorded for training and monitoring purposes!’

She said that maybe the doctor who looked after my dog didn’t want to upset me and add more distress to which I said what? I clearly asked every day for five days if there was more to pay for additional investigations.

Anyway it took them a good while to give all the tests results as i wanted a differential diagnostic and reluctantly they agreed to give them. My dog was put through unnecessary tests, inappropriate for his age and condition that absolutely didn’t make any sense at all.

Two weeks later I was called to bring in my dog for another round of chemo(they didn’t even ask if he was ok after the first one-he wasn’t-he pooped blood) I told them no I do not want that and I specifically said that in writing in the email that they sent a few days before. I also asked how can you give a dog chemo if you hadn’t done all the blood works after the first round and they said they had the initial one from before the chemo.

The second I stated giving a dog chemo without the blood works for his liver, pancreas and overall condition is malpractice and I could sue them for that she hung up the phone.

If you need to be here for an emergency sure but you have to be a doctor yourself not to be fooled by this lot. If not you for sure will get your dog killed here

"Professional" ANTOINE DUCLOS - when you take your pet/s to UCD, remember this name and make sure he doesn't treat your PETS!!!

I really didn't want to leave such a review, but today 01/08 9:45 a.m. I came to the UCD VET with my dog and we had to go for an ultrasound (I made an appointment in advance and wanted to see a coordinating doctor, whom we already had before - Katie). I have already been to this clinic with my cat and pay 2000€ for the examination, I had no complaints about how I and my pet were treated, so I chose this clinic again. But today at 9:45:
1) the students came out and politely asked if I was against it if they talk to me first and then Katie comes out, I say no. My dog is not for experiments, lol. It’s my first visit with my dog and he and me was nervous, nobody noticed us about: “your case will be experimental”
2) Katie came out and asked - I'll go with her to the consultation in the room I said yes, and then she came with Antoine Duclos, as it turned out her “manager” later. And imagine the picture: Katie is silent, before that she also didn't say a word, and this "professional" talks to me like a mother with a child who didn't do his homework: I explain that I don't want students to be present in research with my dog, which I was told: THIS IS NOT MY PROBLEMS (REAL WORDS), how you think I will feeling after this?
3) He said: if you don't trust us, you can leave right now, you'll just have to pay for the consultation (where I'll report you, lol). I told him how I took a day off on purpose, signed up in 2 weeks, called a taxi (it's not easy with a dog) and I heard three more times: THESE ARE NOT MY PROBLEMS. Now think about it: how can SUCH A DOCTOR take care of YOUR PETS if he doesn't know how to build a conversation and says directly: I don't care about anything at all.

Summary :
- Katie, thank you very much for hiding behind your "manager", I'm very sorry that you think it was normal to talk to me like that. I'm grateful to have shown your real face to me
- Antoine, I'm very sorry that in your understanding it is so allowed to talk to: a person, a girl and patient like you talk with me (apparently this is a normal practice in your environment), it's not cool and it will definitely come back to you. If you can work with pets (not sure), I think other people should speak with their owners.
- Director, who speak with me without aggression. I'm very sorry that you couldn't solve the situation where the result could be different: 1) I'm going out and I'm no longer your patient, the dog won't be helped, and students won't be practising; 2) you remove students from my case (they didn't work with every pets) and help my dog, and also get money and everyone is happy. It’s good to know “how much I mean to the clinic as a client"

The result: MY DOG was not helped, the students did not practice, the money was not earned, but my dog was not made worse than it was already, AND THANK YOU FOR U HURT ME, NOT MY DOG 🤝🏻
The care here is outstanding. Our dog went in for spinal surgery and we got updates twice a day on his recovery.
Amazing care towards my Goldie before we sadly lost her x x
Very kind staff and little wait time. My cat received great care late in the evening. Thank you, team!

Great Emergency Vet, my dog got a broken leg and took all the necessary care and steps to ensure everything is all good
Came to a total bill of 604€. Would recommend if its an urgent emergency
Thanks for everyone at the vets 🤍 …

Great experience. Everyone was very kind and we got great results from his tests! Highly recommend to go with any allergies/ long term allergy or itching problems. There's a few months wait so talk to your vet and get the referral.
Expensive and hard to find in the campus but the vets were very caring and helpful. Expect waiting time of up to a few hours!! Bring some snacks if going at night, but a gift in an emergency!!

Very professional, approachable staff. My dog was given a thorough examination and blood test, prescribed medication with a follow up from my own vet. I attended on a Saturday evening, the hospital was very busy so we had a long wait however the care and attention my dog received was worth it.
What a fabulous facility. Thoroughly recommend. 🩷 …
Very professional staff also friendly and polite.

Thank you to all the nurses, receptionists, and doctors for your empathy and professionalism during this difficult time, which I found myself in the middle of the night with my beloved Hopi. Your approach is absolutely exceptional, and I thank you again for the unlimited time you dedicated to us.

Hopi my love rest in peace. You are not suffering anymore...a part of me died with your passing💔
Amazing people doing amazing work ..
Very attentive staff and genuinely care about animals.

I went there with my poor bunny who was very sick. He had to be put to sleep which was very sad. The staff were fantastic. They treated him with such gentleness and me with such compassion. They took the time to talk about him and asked me questions about his life, even though it was the middle of the night. I was expecting them to treat the bunny but not to talk to me as much!

I have to thankful to the vet for trying her best to help to my rabbit. However, IMPORTANT YOU DONT HAVE EXOTIC VETERINARY. Please, don’t advertise on the webpage or others veterinary places that you have expertise in the area. I called you and asked if you have exotic veterinary, and you said, yes. Which I took the decision to travel there as my rabbit needed an emergency care. Unfortunately after all time waist on Saturday and to get him seen. Iam told they have everything except an exotic vet. She did her best. Thanks for that but he did not receive the care that he needed. This after his vet declined to see him because was full no capacity. He passed away at 230 pm on Sunday. So i believe he could be around if he would get the specially on time. Everything was so fast.  Ps. After he was seen in UCD and got oxígen and painkiller he got sort back to normal but no the right treatment. That’s why i said he could be around. Please don’t advertise you have exotic veterinary.

I was minding my sisters cat while she was abroad.The cat got very sick and I took to local vet. I ended up paying €1,200 to local vet and before the cat got seriously sick I had used my card a few times that day ( petrol etc). The local vet had pressed upon me how urgent it was to go straight to emergency  pet hospital in UCD. The cat had a cathera in and a fluid line and the vet gave me an extra bag of fluid to take with me (makes sence now). After driving in circles around UCD I finally arrived. The cat was taken off me immediately and I was directed to reception to register him, which I did.
I was told to take a seat and was called after maybe 15mins. A female vet, who I believe was managing the place, spoke very seriously and gravely about the condition of cat ( but no new information) she really wanted to know would I give permission to do  CPR if needed, of course I said yes. I was in a blind panic thinking what would my sisters kids think? She said it would cost minimum €2,000 and I needed to go back to receptionist and pay deposit. The receptionist was lovely, empathetic and she seemed genuinely embarrassed for what transpired. They needed a deposit of €1,000 off me. Before I handed over my card, I told her I thought I had reached my daily limit, but I could probably get €500 and would they take that and the rest would be paid on Monday at 07:00, when collecting cat.
She went back and asked the vet I had been talking to, but she said 'NO. €1,000 upfront or we can't treat the cat'. The receptionist said let's just try your card, it was refused. I wasn't only having palpitations, I was so embarrassed as this all took place in front of all pet owners. I had to beg between tears for them to treat cat. I asked that she bring the rejection slip from my declined card back into vet and explain that I had reached my limit on card as I had to pay local vet earlier and that if they took the €500, there would be no problem paying the balance on collection.
The receptionist came back and said she said no again the vet said ring your bank or ring around friends and family and raise deposit. This was at 17:30 last Saturday ( we arrived about 4pm). Again, it was stated no money no care. I couldn't speak I was so upset. In the end, I had to take cat home and was left waiting  in a  room by myself, only having the vet come and frighten the bejaysus out of me about the way the cat would die. Before, I could take this gentle, beautiful cat home to die I had to pay them €450. They then kept me waiting till after 9pm for cat.
Clearly, they are only there for you, if you have money.
Why would UCD risk their good reputation on these Neo Liberalist charlatans?
Does the Hippocratic oath mean anything to you?
The cat passed that night with me stroking and talking to him. He was comfortable and in no pain. I cried my eyes out and was terrified his little bladder was going to burst, as told by vet. None of that happened - his passing was very peaceful. It was horrible having to break the news to my sister,  and there are 3 children now who are devastated.
SHAME ON YOU, shame on you, where are your morals?
Do Not Go Here, Amoral and Money grabbers. Avoid.
Certainly not for students, so shame on you too UCD, where is the equality or parity of care you espouse to?
😭😭😭😭
Extremely professional and friendly service. Wish people's GPs and hospitals worked like this one!
Good but very expensive

The receptionists are nice but it's obvious the service this hospital provides is solely to squeeze money out of you in a moment where one is feeling like hell obviously if you're having to take your pet to the hospital. The wait, lack of updates and lack of touch/compassion of one of the vets does not equate to the amount of money they charge. I understand they are busy, but a simple 'your dog is doing fine, I'll come out once I can' would have been more than enough. The overall feeling I got is they treat it like a business. I would have no issue paying what I paid and more if the service and attention in a moment of such distress was better than what I received.
Excellent service from medical and surgical teams.  Thank you 👏🏻 …

Fast enough service during emergency hours (night and weekend). Our puppy had swallowed a stone and the staff here did everything they could for him to get back home safe and sound in 24 hours. He wasn’t able to vomit it, so surgery was needed and everything was handled well and smooth. Wound is recovering well, and all advice, paperwork, and support was provided, very helpful. Thank you to all the staff

Terrible place to bring your dogs. They don’t let owners in with them. They take them off you and leave them in a crate until ready. I’ve gone here few times with dogs needing to get sick as they are something they shouldn’t have.
They say on the phone to hurry as quick as you can and when you get there they left us waiting 2 hours to be seen. Makes no sense!

My other dog had a parasite and they charged me roughly 650 for scans and other items, they never tested for the parasite which is very small amount and eventually I got another vet to check.

Crap crap crap and an awful pity this is one of very few animal hospitals open out of hours in Dublin.
Terrible system and not a caring one!

My cat Moose has been attending UCD for investigations of long term medical mysteries and thanks to their help, particularly Dr Katie, we are finally starting to piece together his puzzle.
All the staff we’ve met along the way have been nothing but lovely, and I’ve been particularly impressed with the follow up care with calls and emails to see how he is getting on and to report all of the tests coming back as well as planning the next stages of everything for my boy.
While I know his condition isn’t going to be curable, I feel super supported and assured from all the work that’s going into looking after my boy.
Thank you from all of us, and from the Moose man 🤎

My cat Tom got bitten on the face by another cat. I took him to my vets who cleaned him up and put him on antibiotics but next day the left side of his face swelled. My vet drained it twice over next two weeks but filled with fluid after a couple of days each time so I had to take him to UCD.
He had tests done and Joseph his vet said he appeared to have damage to his salivary gland.
They had to remove entire gland taking care not to damage nerves in the side of his face.
Tom is 2 months over his surgery. He is back to his usual happy healthy self. He remained in UCD for four days.
I received a call from staff every morning letting me know how Tom was doing.
I couldn't emphasise enough how professional and kind Joseph and all the staff were to me my son and Tom.
I just want to say thank you so much.

It has taken me four months to write this review. I was so traumatised by the whole experience with UCD.  My dog had a bad accident and hit his head.  We thought he had trauma to his spinal cord and he was being treated for it by our local vet.  After about a week, when he was getting better, he suddenly started having the most dreadful seizures.  Howling in horrible pain and shaking like an epileptic fit.  We brought him to our vet who ran tests and gave him meds, however he did not provide overnight care so we brought him to UCD to be monitored as the seizures were happening hourly, and the screaming pain the dog was in was almost too much to bear.

When we arrived, everyone was very nice to us and they told us that somebody would call me at 06.00 at the shift handover to let me know how my boy was doing.  They would call me during the night if his condition deteriorated.  I spent a sleepless night with my phone beside me waiting for a call.  6.00 came and went. At 8.00 I called to see if there was an update and asked to speak to a vet.  At 8.30 a vet called me but knew nothing about the case as apparently she hadnt looked at the file.  I told her to go off and read the file and come back to me when she knew something.  Next thing, I get a call from her boss telling me I was difficult!!  The next two days were a nightmare of me not being allowed to see the dog, me calling begging UCD for information on the dog, them refusing to take my calls or answer my questions.  They said they were too busy. I didnt care who called me back, if it was a vet, reception, the accountant, just let me know my dog is alive!  Finally, on day 3 I broke down in tears, begging them to just tell me how he was.  The receptionist called me back and gave me hell, told me I didnt understand how the place worked and pretty much, who the hell did i think i was calling up to ask for answers to whether my dog was alive and ok.  When I said i was really sorry and i didnt mean to cause any offence and that I didnt want my behaviour to impact my dog's treatment in any way, she went mental, saying i was accusing them of being unprofessional and that they would compromise the dogs treatment.  I promised I wasnt, i felt like I was being chastised for being a naughty girl.

I was the only voice to advocate for my dog and of course, i am going to fight tooth and nail for his best treatment and to make sure he was safe.  Who did i think i was to be asking questions? erm...well, I am the person who owns the dog and the person paying the bill.

Finally, when i did get to speak to the vet, she couldnt explain anything clearly to me.  They couldnt give me any answers, they wanted to keep on poking and prodding him and getting me to pay more money for more tests why they tried to figure it out.  Meanwhile, the poor dog was still suffering and in pain.

Enough was enough.  This wasnt in the best interests of the animal.  I made the heartbreaking decision to put him to sleep and end this madness and his suffering.

These are the roughest days with your dog, you are scared, worried, suffering lack of sleep.  Communication is a gift and and if you provide a service it is your responsibility to communicate with your customers.  I can only say, I will never forgive UCD for what they put me and my dog through for those 3 days.

I do not recommend going to this place.  Go to Summerhill, they are lovely and treat the animals and humans with respect.
Emergency room needs a private area where people can can talk to staff without the entire wait room knowing your business.
Amazing service and care from the team here. I can’t speak highly enough of their sill and compassion.

My dog Luna saved my life from a vicious dog.my poor dog ended up not been able to walk but then when we had been seen she could walk kinda and was not bleeding anymore this is the best veterinary I know
I spent 5 hours in the hospital my dog was not seen . We had to leave my dog was in a lot of pain until we brought him to our vet on Monday . UCD poor staffing .
We had to rush to the hospital during the night with our dog. Staff was nice and supportive

My dog got into chocolate I foolishly left out and I called the vet as soon as I noticed. They booked him in straight away and as soon as I got there a lovely vet took us right in. He was in and out in 40 minutes or so. Thank you to the wonderful staff for helping my Odin ❤️

The Vet at the Emergency wing is so inexperienced, she was scared of a nervous barking dog and did not treat us well. Just sent home a bleeding dog with pain meds. She did not even attempt to befriend our dog and labelled him aggressive and us as encouraging that behaviour whilst he was just hurt and running a temperature in the middle of the night. It was a waste of money, time and effort to rush to emergency there, just to be sent home with no useful solution.
Maps continually sent me down blind alleys and into car parks with no through road. Told me to take a left or right turn or exit a roundabout when there was clearly no turn or exit available.

If your pets need something important done or checked, they're the best option.

Well, the only one, but they have a great track record and they've always been extremely accurate and professional.
Very professional and respectful staff.. Makes going there for treatment a lithle more bearable for the dog
Amazing and looked after our dog with such care. Was so comforting knowing he was so well looked after at such a worrying time
Diagnosed my dog wrong and left her with an open wound, killed my dog who was my best friend (coming from a 13 year old girl who misses her best friend) :(

I have to say I was very impressed & so so grateful for saving my little pet bella. They looked after her so well.
Bella had made a full recovery. Vets are so lovely, caring & understanding.
Highly recommended.
Thank you from Tracey

If possible, choose another hospital.
UCD is only interested in money, not in the help to family pet....because they know that people will pay more, and more to save their beloved pet....
After spending the night in the hospital - our dog was not able to walk anymore. She couldn't leave the hospital by herself....
They ordered the dog to be given antibiotics, which did not help...
And, refused to change antibiotics.
Words I will say are bad, but I wish to UCD hospital exactly the same from what our beloved dog suffered, and how she feeled after attending hospital.
In UCD hospital working vets (students) without heart.
Very ill pets are used as experiments for students.
And that is not ok...
Experts. My dog recovered there from surgery few years back, thank you.

Shocking experience,  sent home with my beautiful golden retriever, told she was stable, to take her to my own vet for further exploration,  charged €1000.00 and yet her symptoms continued, heartbreaking to watch. We put her to sleep two days later, she suffered unnecessarily.

The vet Tara was not particularly kind or helpful to us in (what we didn't know were) the last few hours of my dogs life. They asked for an update front payment of over 1000 euro which surprised us and when we asked if it needed to be paid immediately, she said "obviously" and told us to "borrow it" if we didn't have it. Truly not a kind or compassionate person. Later spoke to a lovely girl at reception and a vet named Ken who was very helpful in a very difficult time for our family.
Would highly recommend this service if your pet is injured or sick. The staff are very professional & friendly. Nacho is such a caring vet. We would recommend having pet insurance first.

Have been there with my dog around 2am, he cut off his nail, apparently it was fixed, my dog is nervous so they have to sedate him. Next morning 7am I woke up the bandage was off and the nail bleeding again, had to go to another vet. Sent an email to complain, the obnoxious guy called me to explain about the procedure which I knew it. At the end he asked me what else do I want. I didn’t want refund I just wanted them to be aware of their lack of professionalism and knowledge. My dog’s vet saw the procedure they had done and told me it was completely wrong. So a few hours later my dog was under sedation again to fix what UCD vets didn’t and charged me 350 for it plus the ridiculous call from the obnoxious man.
Wonderful staff, literal life savers for pets!!    I've been there a few times and they've never let me down.
Thanks for your job 🙏❤️ …

One the nurses was absolutely horrific. Didn’t read the room when she could tell I was panicked and upset about my puppy having another seizure. She was so rude when I asked a simple question and my friend and myself witnessed her rude manner when she was talking to other people in the waiting room. We were shocked at how bad her people skills were. Made me so uncomfortable. She was northern Irish I think. Hope I don’t run into her ever again.
Very caring and efficient
Fantastic hospital to deal with, from the reception team to the vet students and interns.
Very good hospital 🏥 …
